# Academy Productivity Rankings {.unlisted}

I led Training Ground Guru’s study of how academies in England and Wales develop senior footballers. I built an AI-assisted workflow to trace each player’s academy history and share credit across the clubs that trained him. Plymouth Argyle commissioned the first club report to benchmark its academy against its peers.

[Explore the series](#the-tgg-series){.academy-action} [Inside the masterclass](#inside-the-masterclass)
::::

::: {.academy-pathway}
### From player to ranking {.unlisted .unanchored}

<ol>
<li><strong>Trace the player</strong><span>Start with the player’s senior record and trace academy spells in public sources.</span></li>
<li><strong>Check the evidence</strong><span>The AI agent cross-checks identity and dates, follows gaps and links each finding to a source.</span></li>
<li><strong>Share the credit</strong><span>Use Opta’s league strengths and minutes played to score the senior season. Split the points by time at each academy.</span></li>
</ol>
:::
:::::

::: {.academy-scope}
<div><strong>2,067</strong> players researched</div>
<div><strong>89</strong> academies ranked</div>
<div><strong>23</strong> senior competitions</div>
:::

## How clubs used the rankings

**Plymouth Argyle commissioned the first bespoke report.** Across 23 pages, we compared the academy with named peers and broke down which graduates, leagues and age groups contributed to its score. Each report includes a call with me to discuss the findings. [TGG’s announcement and sample report pages](https://trainingground.guru/clubs-can-now-commission-a-bespoke-tgg-academy-productivity-report/)
